title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Light Acceptances Free of the Loading Surcharge
content:
## Clause

Dangerous Goods Acceptance waives the hazardous-cargo loading surcharge for acceptances light enough to fall under the category's surcharge-free weight. When the gross weight declared on the acceptance is below that figure, the surcharge amount is 0.00. A figure of 0 means that no acceptance is ever free of the surcharge on this ground.

## Surcharge-free weight per category (kilograms of gross weight per acceptance)

| Category | Surcharge-free below |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 5000 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 0 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 0 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 0 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0 |

## Boundary cases

| Category | Declared gross weight (kg) | Below the figure? | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 4999.9 | yes | 0.00 |
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 5000.0 | no | charged in the ordinary way |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 800.0 | no, the figure is 0 | charged in the ordinary way |

## Point of judgement

**Is the weight compared per container?** No; the comparison uses the gross weight declared for the acceptance as a whole.
